description: Current registration load. About 2% of charts are injected extra charts with the usual mix of typos, nicknames, transposed dates, and missing identifiers.
Two fictional hospitals combined their registration files. About 9% of charts are extra charts, mostly in a different source system from the original.
The same duplicate rate ballpark as baseline, with much more missing SSN and phone, invalid formats, and name typos on charts that are not duplicates.

Twins who share a last name, birth date, address, and phone; households that share a phone and address; and a pile of common names such as John Smith. These are different people. Precision should fall because some of them look like duplicates.

The laboratory feed was loaded from a legacy system. Lab charts systematically drop SSN, often drop or garble the phone, and sometimes send an unusable birth date or address. Registration and billing are unchanged.
